meta.title: Self-psychology supervision
meta.description: Adds the self-psychology supervision skill to the session skill catalog. Submit a case and ask for supervision, or load self-psychology-supervision by name with the skill tool; the instructions read the module prompts in assets/prompts and write the report in the current session, so no external service is called and the case text only reaches the model this session already uses. Turning the bundle off removes the skill from the catalog.
